_help: Ubuntu: copy to /etc/trygons/gateway.json; Windows: %PROGRAMDATA%\trygons\gateway.json. Passwords go into secrets.json (never into git). Serial names: python gateway.py --list-serial. Check: python gateway.py --config <this file> --check-config
_aurix: the 3.3 V TTL USB-UART adapter (NEVER RS232: +-12 V destroys the AURIX pins). Both OSes: usb:VID:PID:SERIAL; Ubuntu also /dev/serial/by-id/usb-...; Windows also COMn (the number can change)

ais._source: the USB AIS receiver, named like the AURIX adapter

storage._root: leave out = the PC's own SSD (/var/lib/trygons/data or %PROGRAMDATA%\trygons\data); an external SSD: its folder + require_mount true

harbour._help: Harbour autonomy sensors (CLAUDE.md Z, docs/harbour_design.md 5a, step HX3): each sensor = its own worker process (gateway/harbour/radar_worker.py / lidar_worker.py). sim true = the SIMULATED radar + LiDAR from the harbour world (world = a file from demo/demo_world.py, '' = the built-in harbour around the boat's first position). driver: sim | mayara (radar) | livox / ouster (LiDAR) = SKELETONS ONLY until the owner chooses (W148): they stay OFFLINE. Health OK / DEGRADED / LOST = notices only, never an alarm or a mode change

adsb._help: ADS-B receive only (CLAUDE.md X K4, PF5): a 1090 MHz RTL-SDR + readsb / dump1090. source = its SBS port (30003) or Beast (30005, proto beast); decoder 'auto' = start readsb / dump1090 found by toolpaths.py (python tools/get_readsb.py), '' = it already runs; sim = a simulated helicopter (demo / tests). max_alt_ft / max_km = the display + warning filter

uav._help: UAV magazine (CLAUDE.md V): false = no magazine on this boat. Each slot = the FIXED hub USB port of that slot (usbloc:<port path>, python gateway.py --list-serial), never the drone's own id; slot 1 = the top one
uav._slots_help: radio = the serial name of that drone's ELRS TX module (MAVLink mode, W70): the launch needs the drone's altitude once its slot cable is gone
uav._hatch_help: U3: hatch_relay = n of the boat's EXISTING relay table (an extra onoff relay, power_up off, no pair; the boat file's "uav": {"hatch_relay": n} too: W57 b, relays 1-7 are used = a board with >= 8 channels). hatch port = the FT232R breakout of the two limit switches (CTS = OPEN, DSR = CLOSED, switch to GND, external pull-ups: W57 a); open_s / close_s = the travel time limits (TO CONFIRM with the actuator)
uav._launch_help: W59 (owner 2026-11-04): no launch speed limit - high_speed_kn 5 = the NON-blocking HIGH SPEED notice only; gps_wait_s 30 (UAV-r1 / W138: no GPS fix in this time with the hatch open = the launch STOPS - no launch without GPS, no climb fallback), clear_alt_m 10, gap_s 15, init_alt_base_m 30 + init_alt_step_m 5 per slot; check: uav_max_alt_m 120, uav_rf_range_m 1500, uav_wp_alt_m 50, uav_land_margin_pct 30
uav._video_help: U4: the six analog VRX + USB capture devices (one per slot, its VRX on the slot's fixed channel, W63): dshow:video=<name> on Windows (ffmpeg -list_devices true -f dshow -i dummy), v4l2:/dev/v4l/by-path/<port> on Ubuntu (the USB port = the slot), sim = the simulated VRX pictures. Encoded ONCE (Quick Sync when the probe works, else x264 ultrafast) into MediaMTX uav_<n> + the ring UAV-<n> (in every SAVE / KEEP). Only flying drones are encoded; always = slots encoded also in the magazine (a bench test)
uav._ai_help: U4: eWaSR on the UAV feeds open on a screen, round robin, 0.5 fps in all, only while the boat's front camera AI does not need the CPU; boxes + notices only (W62: aerial views are outside its training)
